intro: Technology and government sectors bore the brunt of the 35 zero-day exploits tracked from April to August 2026, with 18 rated high and 16 critical. APT29, Chaotic Eclipse, and Claude Mythos were observed in campaigns spanning Global, Asia, Brazil, China, and Europe, affecting telecommunications, critical infrastructure, and enterprise networks. Top vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-22679 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-34621 (CVSS 8.6), CVE-2026-3502 (CVSS 7.8), CVE-2026-32183 (CVSS 7.5), and CVE-2026-68820 (CVSS 7). One medium-severity issue rounded out the archive.
